annotations.title: Check a routine against what a person avoids

description: Check every step of a YogaMag routine against what the person cannot or does not want to do (the floor, kneeling, weight on the wrists). Each step is kept, swapped for an easier version that the pose's reviewed data lists, marked as having no supported alternative, or marked not assessed. It never invents a substitute; the result is the YogaMag routine with listed swaps, not a new routine.

avoid.description: What the person cannot or does not want to do: floor = cannot get down to the floor, kneeling = cannot kneel, wrists = no weight on the wrists

slug.description: Slug of the routine, as returned by find_routine or search_content
